name: crust-render
description: Look-dev and lighting by conversation: keep a USD stage open, edit it through an override layer, and render it with crust, a physically based path tracer.
long_description: A session works on one USD stage through an override layer that sublayers it. Every edit is an opinion saved in that layer, and what is rendered is always the saved layer, imported as `crust render <layer>` imports it. The layer and its final render are the session's result: any USD tool opens the layer. Nothing else is written. See https://doubleailes.github.io/crust-render/docs/help/claude-desktop/

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Open a USD stage through an override layer, or resume one.

tools.name: query
tools.description: What the stage composes at a prim or an attribute, and which layer says so.

tools.name: check
tools.description: The crust check report of the session's layer.

tools.name: set_attribute
tools.description: Author an attribute value in the override layer.

tools.name: bind_material
tools.description: Bind a material to a prim.

tools.name: author_usda
tools.description: Merge a USDA snippet into the override layer as one edit.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Restore the layer as it was before the last edit.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Start a progressive render and return within a time budget with the image so far.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: A render's latest image and progress.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Stop a render, keeping what it traced.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: A pixel's beauty and AOV values.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two renders as crust diff compares two images.

tools.name: render_final
tools.description: Render the layer as crust render would, and list the files written.
